attributes.description: Operator audit of RigSignal capture integrity: coverage matrix (stream x session/time), unstamped/placeholder findings (no-session sentinel & null ids), cadence gaps, and honest correlation completeness. Missing is never shown as zero. No session UUIDs or absolute timestamps are hard-coded.
